objective: Closed-Loop 4-Stage Actor-Critic UI/UX Pipeline (Forensic Analyst -> Brand/Style Planner -> Clean ReAct Worker <-> Read-Only WCAG 2.2 OKLCH Judge) with <= 5 Active Rules per Node
acceptance_criteria: Stage 0 (ui-analyst): Inventory tokens, colors, fonts, icons, menus, spacing, contracts, stack, DevTools/REA telemetry, AI Slop score, and CLAREZA Before/After navigation diagram

Stage 1 (ui-planner): Calibrate brand OKLCH 60-30-10 (zero neon), select Style Archetype (Soft..Clinical) & Spatial Archetype (of 6), source Stitch/Figma/Fonts/3D assets, emit DESIGN.md blueprint, and compile <=5-rule DAG without file collisions

Stage 2 (ui-worker): Materialize DESIGN.md on disk and implement clean Light/Dark UI with 3-layer light shadows, dark-mode specular rim/halo lighting, superior matte glass, @container/subgrid, 4 Card Variants, real FSM, and Read-After-Write SHA-256 + tsc verification

Stage 3 (ui-judge): Run read-only WCAG 2.2 OKLCH contrast (FNR < 0.001), 4-Pillar Readiness (>= 90), 6-Dimension UI/UX (>= 85), 48x48px touch, :focus-visible, DOM==Tab, anti-XSS, and anti-Slop checks; loop Self-Refine on REJECTED up to max_refinement_rounds=3 before HITL escalation

tasks.description: Stage 0: Forensic inventory, Chrome DevTools probe, AI Slop score, and Before/After navigation refactor proposals
Stage 1: Brand, OKLCH 60-30-10, 7 Style Archetypes, Stitch/Figma/Fonts/3D assets, zero-verbiage UX, DESIGN.md & bounded DAG
Stage 2: ReAct clean Light/Dark implementation, matte glass, dark rim lighting, RAW SHA-256 + tsc verification
Stage 3: Read-only WCAG 2.2 OKLCH Judge (FNR < 0.001) + Actor-Critic Self-Refine loop back to stage2_ui_worker
